The first elected mayor of Kathmandu in 1953 was Tulsi Lal Amatya, based on my recollection; I still have no way to check a source here. The team note's claim that the name begins with "Janak" conflicts with that, and I can't confirm it either, so it should be checked against a reference such as Wikipedia's list of Kathmandu mayors.
CONFIDENCE: 55
